LESSON: DESCANT RECORDER

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.6: Descant Recorder
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Descant Recorder, part of Creating and Performing in Grade 7 CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS.

Key inquiry question: What is the value of sight reading music? 2. Why are performance directions important in music?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. outline factors to consider in interpreting melodies on staff notation,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Descant Recorder in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. sight read simple melodies on descant recorder from staff notation,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Descant Recorder in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. play a piece in C major on a descant recorder,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Descant Recorder in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. perform simple melodies on a descant recorder observing performance directions,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Descant Recorder in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. appreciate playing music in C major on the descant recorder.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Descant Recorder in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. perform simple melodies on a descant recorder observing performance directions,

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-Efficacy: the learner, while executing solo pieces, exhibits self-efficacy, fostering personal growth.

• Digital Literacy: the learner demonstrates digital literacy in preparing and sharing musical ideas, accessing sheet music,

online tutorials, and other collaborative spaces.

• Learning to Learn: the learner consistently practises, adjusts, and seeks feedback, reflecting a self-directed and adaptive

learning approach.
